claim: Demo sample data is isolated, is not saved, and resets on demand or exit.
sandbox: fresh context at /?demo=1; edit and reset sample; preserve real storage sentinels; prove real-to-demo and demo-to-real transitions discard the prior document

claim: PDF work stays on this device and no PDF is uploaded.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; intercept the complete edit and export flow; assert same-origin GET requests only and no API, upload, or analytics request

claim: Field Desk and the sample PDF can reopen offline after the first visit.
where: first-screen facts, landing privacy section, Privacy, README
sandbox: fresh context; load /demo once, wait for the atomic offline-ready signal, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample editor opens from a same-origin-only cache

claim: Field Desk accepts PDF files only.
sandbox: fresh landing; choose a text file and assert the specific PDF-only recovery message
fresh landing; choose a PDF whose observed size is 176 MB and assert rejection before parsing

claim: Standard PDF text, choice, and checkbox fields retain edited values in editable downloads.
where: How it works, README, export dialog
sandbox: fresh /demo; edit its text, dropdown, and checkbox controls; download and inspect all values in the resulting PDF

claim: New text, checkbox, and date fields can be added and downloaded as editable controls.
sandbox: fresh /demo; place each field kind, download an editable PDF, and inspect the three new AcroForm controls

claim: Drawn and typed signatures export as visual marks, not verified digital signatures.
sandbox: fresh /demo; create and place typed and drawn signatures; download a valid PDF and assert no digital-signature field exists

claim: Pages can move, rotate, be removed, and be restored before download.
sandbox: fresh /demo; move its landscape page first, rotate, remove, undo, download, and inspect page count, order dimensions, and rotation

claim: Downloads can keep fields editable or make them permanent.
where: How it works, README, export dialog
sandbox: fresh /demo; download each mode and inspect that editable fields remain in one PDF and no form fields remain in the permanent PDF

claim: Opened PDFs are cleared when the tab reloads or closes.
sandbox: fresh /demo; exit to real mode, open a generated PDF, reload, and assert the file and editor are absent
fresh /demo; complete a download with no sign-in control and no authentication request

claim: Field Desk is free to use.
sandbox: fresh /demo; complete a download with no checkout, payment, upgrade control, or billing request

claim: Field Desk does not read scanned text.
sandbox: enter through /demo, start for real, open an image-only PDF, and assert no text field is inferred and no OCR action exists

claim: Field Desk does not edit text already printed on a PDF page.
sandbox: enter through /demo, open a PDF with printed page text, and assert the canvas remains static while only the add-text-field tool is available

claim: Field Desk rejects dynamic XFA forms because it cannot edit their fields.
sandbox: enter through /demo, open a generated XFA PDF, and assert the specific XFA rejection appears and no editor opens
